answer: The orbits in the nebula are charted at payout, and the vine ties every pearl to its star. Every identity backs its claim with a 1,500,000 POA stake. Two pearls on one orbit belong to one operator: both rewards burn, both stakes pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 700,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 2,200,000 POA, and two fakes cost 4,400,000 POA before any payout clears.
